samples.rationale: Apex fails due to lapsed SOC 2 certification. Cirrus fails on data residency. Delta's true cost ($187,000) exceeds the $180,000 cap. Only Borealis meets all four hard constraints with no disqualifying finding, at $155,000.

Each vendor must satisfy all four hard constraints. Apex fails on valid SOC 2 certification. Cirrus fails on data residency. Delta fails on budget once the mandatory $12,000 fee is included ($187,000 > $180,000). Only Borealis meets every constraint with no disqualifying finding and a cost within budget. Therefore Borealis is the lowest-cost compliant vendor.

Though slower than Hotfix, Hotfix is disqualified, making Failover the only compliant and therefore fastest compliant path.

Hotfix is irreversible without CAB approval, violating a hard constraint. Rollback depends on an unavailable vendor API, also a constraint violation. Rebuild exceeds the two-hour window.
